Method of Attack: Ransomware installer distributed via zipped WSF files in emails pretending to be banking reports, invoices, or shipping information; uses Jscript code to download and install ransomware; encrypts data files and renames them with .zepto extension
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (due to use of Windows Script Files)
Attack Vector: Email attachments containing zipped WSF files
Indicators of Compromise: zipped WSF email attachments pretending to be banking reports, invoices, or shipping information
